pain_points.statement: Finance is significantly delayed in processing invoices due to data discrepancies.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

desired_state.statement: The client wants a fixed-fee engagement with milestone payments and a firm price.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I want a number in the proposal. Not a range. A number.

success_criteria.statement: Improve Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) to free up working capital.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: return to five-day DSO... frees up about $1.4M in working capital

risks_unknowns.statement: There is a disagreement on the approved budget for the Phase 1 engagement.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: the budget I approved is $300,000. That's the cap.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: The CFO (Rita) insists the budget is strictly capped at $300k, while the VP of Ops (Sarah) claims they discussed a range of $250k to $400k.

risks_unknowns.statement: Missing the ELD compliance deadline could result in fines or loss of operating authority.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Fines, possibly losing our operating authority in some states.

pain_points.statement: The current dispatch tool (Routemaster) has severe technical debt, making feature development extremely slow.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Technical debt in Routemaster. We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile.

desired_state.statement: The CTO wants to completely replace the legacy dispatch tool with a third-party SaaS platform.
desired_state.source_excerpt: live on it in nine months and we'd never have to maintain Routemaster again.

desired_state.statement: Build workflow logic as a portable layer on top of the existing system.
desired_state.source_excerpt: workflow logic in a layer on top of Routemaster, talking to Salesforce and the driver app

success_criteria.statement: A majority of the new workflow logic must be reusable if the underlying platform is replaced.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

risks_unknowns.statement: Changes to the driver app must be carefully coordinated with the separate ELD compliance workstream.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: If we're going to touch the driver app, the ELD work has to be coordinated.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers suffer from excessive manual data entry between systems.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

pain_points.statement: Drivers are highly dissatisfied with the current mobile application.

desired_state.statement: Incrementally fix specific operational workflows without waiting for a full platform replacement.
desired_state.source_excerpt: fix three specific operational pain points... incrementally, within the budget

success_criteria.statement: Reduce dispatch time to avoid the need for additional headcount.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: 30% reduction in dispatch time means we don't need to hire four additional dispatchers

risks_unknowns.statement: Previous internal attempts to fix the dispatcher workflow have failed.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

pain_points.statement: Leadership is fundamentally misaligned on whether the core issue is a workflow problem or a platform problem.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Sarah and I have been having a parallel conversation about this for months and we don't agree

desired_state.statement: Deploy a pilot to production by the end of Q3 to secure funding.
desired_state.source_excerpt: If we don't have something in production by end of September, the funding gets reallocated.

success_criteria.statement: The proposed solution must not interfere with the upcoming ELD compliance mandate.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: whatever we build needs to not get in the way of the compliance work.

risks_unknowns.statement: There is disagreement on the feasibility and commitment to the Q3 pilot deadline.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: I never agreed to Q3. I think Q4 is more realistic
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: The CFO and VP of Ops mandate a Q3 deadline to keep funding, but the CTO states he never agreed to it and believes Q4 is more realistic.
